description: This file defines the data model for chat messages and the ChatProvider class that manages chat state, including message history, assistant replies, and chat seed initialization for a Flutter-based AI tutoring app.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: Model representing a single chat message with id, text, sender indicator, and timestamp.

classes.name: ChatProvider
classes.description: State management class extending ChangeNotifier, handling chat message list, user and assistant interactions, seed initialization, and reply simulation.

methods.name: seedIfEmpty
methods.description: Initializes chat with sample messages if message list is empty.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Adds a user message and triggers an assistant reply after a delay.

methods.name: insertSuggestionAndSend
methods.description: Inserts a suggestion prompt and sends it immediately.

methods.name: _simulateAssistantReply
methods.description: Simulates assistant reply after a short delay, updates message list.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all chat messages and resets assistant typing indicator.
